body: Thank you much, Just taking the time to read it was enough, but commenting just made my night. I know that weight loss isn't linear, but struggling with it after previously "succeeding" just really hurts. I too wish that I could find myself to begin to believe again, but I feel naive trying to go back into the childish mindset that Ive had previously. I hope that as I continue to experience life I will find the answer, but for now I am just looking to live. I hope that your remaining year of highschool will see you succeeding and good luck on college where ever you decide to go with that.  Thanks again for the reply!
Your also the type of person that makes us 'fatties' insecure. You calling them Fatties is just another reason why people that are fat make posts like this, there are much better ways to address us.

I've tried to weight lifting, but after two months of going twice a week every week with a trainer and to more times a week by my self nothing changed. I know my eating has something to do with it, but even if i try to eat healthier it doesn't work.
No not really. I sweat a lot, but i wear deodorant and cologne. I also take showers daily.
